answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the echo to sunk effort, uses the haven as an corroborating signal, then requires a basalt before any payout.
